newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda to unveil North America restructuring plan.
newsitem.headline: Mazda to unveil North America restructuring plan.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp said it would unveil a restructuring plan for its North American operations at 10.30 a.m. (0130 GMT) on Friday.
A Mazda spokesman did not give further details on the announcement.

The spokesman said he could not confirm a report by the financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun on Friday that Mazda plans to consolidate its loss-making North American operations and to cut about 20 percent of its 1,500 workers at subsidiaries in the United States and Canada in order to reduce costs.
The newspaper reported that the streamlining may also involve transferring some of Mazda's North American operations to Ford Motor Co, which has a 33.3 percent stake in the Japanese automaker.

The newspaper also said that Mazda plans to integrate the operations of Mazda (North America) Inc, which is in charge of quality control for Mazda vehicles made in the United States, and its sales subsidiary Mazda Motor of America Inc.

Mazda will also scale back its research arm, Mazda Research & Development of North America Inc, the paper said. It added that a joint development plan between Mazda and Ford had eliminated the need for Mazda to have its own research and development arm.
